effect.name: Tails7 Polygon Colored Vertex With Addition (Texture) [Flat Shading]
effect.description: The shader transforms the texture to give a polygon effect based on points A, and C also adds the color of the polygon by the colors assigned to the points [Flat Shading]. (Mainly intended for Tails7 R1.0.3+)
effect.author: Foxioo (Special thanks to PsichiX for creating the Vertex Shader Test)

parameter.name: /* Foxioo's Tails7 Polygon Colored Vertex With Addition (Texture) [Flat Shading] | 1.2 (05.04.2026) */
parameter.description: The shader transforms the texture to give a polygon effect based on points A, and C also adds the color of the polygon by the colors assigned to the points [Flat Shading]. (Mainly intended for Tails7 R1.0.3+)

parameter.name: Color A (-X -Y)
parameter.description: Color of point A (Top left point)

parameter.name: Color C (+X +Y)
parameter.description: Color of point C (Bottom right point)

parameter.name: Screen Width
parameter.description: This variable must store frame width.

parameter.name: Screen Height
parameter.description: This variable must store frame height.

parameter.name: Error Thresholdt
parameter.description: This value determines the error threshold at which the shader should not be rendered (prevents artifacts, recommended value is 0.001).

parameter.name: Position X
parameter.description: A variable that determines the position of the texture in the X axis.

parameter.name: Position Y
parameter.description: A variable that determines the position of the texture in the Y axis.

parameter.name: Scale
parameter.description: This variable determines the overall scale of the texture (in X and Y axes).

parameter.name: Scale X
parameter.description: This variable determines the scale of the texture in the X axis.

parameter.name: Scale Y
parameter.description: This variable determines the scale of the texture in the Y axis.

parameter.name: A (Visibility)
parameter.description: This variable must store the visibility information of the object to determine whether point A is behind or in front of the camera.

parameter.name: xA (-X -Y)
parameter.description: X of point A (Top left point)

parameter.name: yA (-X -Y)
parameter.description: Y of point A (Top left point)

parameter.name: B (Visibility)
parameter.description: This variable must store the visibility information of the object to determine whether point B is behind or in front of the camera.

parameter.name: xB (+X -Y)
parameter.description: X of point B (Top right point)

parameter.name: yB (+X -Y)
parameter.description: Y of point B (Top right point)

parameter.name: C (Visibility)
parameter.description: This variable must store the visibility information of the object to determine whether point C is behind or in front of the camera.

parameter.name: xC (+X +Y)
parameter.description: X of point C (Bottom right point)

parameter.name: yC (+X +Y)
parameter.description: Y of point C (Bottom right point)

parameter.name: D (Visibility)
parameter.description: This variable must store the visibility information of the object to determine whether point D is behind or in front of the camera.

parameter.name: xD (-X +Y)
parameter.description: X of point D (Bottom left point)

parameter.name: yD (-X +Y)
parameter.description: Y of point D (Bottom left point)
